title: Tommy vs Alfie — first chapter preparation

source_quality.source_metadata_note: Actual BBC clip measured 1920x1080/25fps; English original audio, no burned subtitles. Native source stills reviewed. BBC identification retained; this is first-chapter preparation, not the full production.

opening.speaker: white
opening.label: Tommy
opening.evidence: Actual 0.6s/2.3s opening frames show Tommy; ASR and public caption text confirm his police payroll line comes first in this selected clip.

outro_summary: Tommy arrives with information. Alfie answers with threats, a war story and an increasingly elaborate plan for disposing of his own cabinet. Tommy keeps the discussion on business. Eventually Alfie remembers that this was supposed to be a meeting.

annotations.speaker: white
annotations.comment: Tommy opens with police connections. A perfectly normal business introduction, provided your business is a crime empire.
annotations.review_method: Local word-timed ASR, public captions and actual native source stills reviewed; original humorous editorial analysis. No continuous human listening claimed.
